description: Held-out corpus for the protected-meaning gate. Every pair states governance prose twice. Equivalent pairs differ only in wording and MUST compare 'equivalent'; changed pairs alter propositional content and MUST compare 'changed'. Authored from the semantics of governance directives, deliberately NOT from the phrasings in any profile or in recommended-decision.json, so that a gate which memorises fixture wording cannot pass it.

actor_policy.rule: unspecified -> named is permitted; named -> different named is a change; named -> unspecified is a change
actor_policy.rationale: LING-AGENCY-001 penalises agentless obligations and its remediation instructs the writer to name the responsible party. A gate that treated naming an actor as a meaning change would reject the very rewrite the analyzer demands. Specifying an unspecified actor adds accountability without altering the directive; swapping or erasing a named actor reassigns or destroys it.

equivalent_pairs.left: Defer ratification of the interface contract.
equivalent_pairs.right: Do not ratify the interface contract yet.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Deferral expressed as a nominalized object versus a negated verb with a temporal marker.

equivalent_pairs.right: Do not begin the irreversible database cutover yet.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Deferring an event noun is equivalent to not beginning it yet.

equivalent_pairs.left: Hold off on retiring the legacy broker.
equivalent_pairs.right: Defer retirement of the legacy broker.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Two deferral operators over the same complement.

equivalent_pairs.left: The platform team must resolve the authorization gaps.
equivalent_pairs.right: The authorization gaps must be resolved by the platform team.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Voice alternation with the agent retained.
Declared action synonyms under the normalization policy.

equivalent_pairs.left: Verify the two outstanding data loss hypotheses.
equivalent_pairs.right: Verify the 2 outstanding data loss hypotheses.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Numeral spelled versus written as a digit.

equivalent_pairs.right: Check the two critical replication hypotheses.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: 'both' denotes exactly two over a definite plural.

equivalent_pairs.left: Require closure of the outstanding audit findings.
equivalent_pairs.right: Require that the outstanding audit findings be closed.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Nominalized complement versus finite subordinate clause.

equivalent_pairs.left: A human must approve the target topology.
equivalent_pairs.right: The target topology requires human approval.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Obligation expressed from the actor side versus the object side.

equivalent_pairs.left: The service owner is required to verify the retention schedule.
equivalent_pairs.right: The service owner must verify the retention schedule.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: 'is required to' and 'must' are the same deontic modality.

equivalent_pairs.left: Do not deploy the ingress gateway.
equivalent_pairs.right: The ingress gateway must not be deployed.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Negated imperative versus negated passive obligation.

equivalent_pairs.left: Treat the current topology as a provisional baseline.
equivalent_pairs.right: The current topology is only a provisional baseline.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Directive framing versus predicative framing of the same status.

equivalent_pairs.right: The reliability team must verify the failover runbook.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Naming a previously unspecified actor is permitted specification; see actor_policy. This is the rewrite LING-AGENCY-001 explicitly asks for.

equivalent_pairs.left: Confirm the retention policy and publish the migration plan.
equivalent_pairs.right: Confirm the retention policy. Publish the migration plan.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Coordinated imperatives split into separate sentences; two claims either way.

equivalent_pairs.left: Close the audit findings before the design returns for sign-off.
equivalent_pairs.right: The design returns for sign-off only after the audit findings are closed.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Same ordering constraint stated from either side.

equivalent_pairs.left: Use the repository-evidenced topology as the baseline.
equivalent_pairs.right: Use the topology that the repository evidences as the baseline.
equivalent_pairs.rationale: Compound modifier unpacked into a relative clause; no propositional change.

changed_pairs.left: Do not begin the irreversible V2 cutover yet.
changed_pairs.right: Do not begin the irreversible V3 cutover yet.

changed_pairs.left: Do not ratify the interface contract yet.
changed_pairs.rationale: The prohibition is inverted into an instruction.

changed_pairs.left: Verify the two outstanding data loss hypotheses.
changed_pairs.right: Verify the three outstanding data loss hypotheses.
changed_pairs.rationale: The count of protected items changed.

changed_pairs.left: A human must approve the target topology.
changed_pairs.right: An automated pipeline must approve the target topology.
changed_pairs.rationale: Approval authority is reassigned away from a person.

changed_pairs.left: The platform team must resolve the authorization gaps.
changed_pairs.right: The authorization gaps must be resolved.
changed_pairs.rationale: A named accountable party is erased; see actor_policy.

changed_pairs.left: The service owner must verify the retention schedule.
changed_pairs.right: The service owner should verify the retention schedule.
changed_pairs.rationale: An obligation is downgraded to a recommendation.

changed_pairs.left: Defer ratification of the interface contract.
changed_pairs.rationale: 'not yet' is not 'not ever'; deferral becomes permanent prohibition.
Recording a concern is not resolving it.
Authorization and authentication are different subsystems.

changed_pairs.left: Require closure evidence for the outstanding findings.
changed_pairs.right: Closure evidence for the outstanding findings is optional.
changed_pairs.rationale: A mandatory gate is made discretionary.

changed_pairs.left: Close the audit findings before the design returns for sign-off.
changed_pairs.right: Close the audit findings after the design returns for sign-off.

changed_pairs.left: Verify whether the replication path can lose data.
changed_pairs.rationale: An open hypothesis is asserted as established fact.

changed_pairs.left: Treat the current topology as a provisional baseline.
changed_pairs.right: Treat the current topology as the target architecture.
changed_pairs.rationale: A provisional current-state view is promoted to an endorsed target.

changed_pairs.left: Confirm the retention policy and publish the migration plan.
changed_pairs.rationale: One of two coordinated directives is dropped.

changed_pairs.right: Confirm the retention policy and decommission the legacy broker.
changed_pairs.rationale: A destructive directive absent from the source is introduced.

known_gaps.ch-action-swapped: Both actions are sentence-initial imperatives that the parser tags as nouns, so neither side yields a claim to compare. Reported unresolved.
known_gaps.ch-scope-narrowed: Quantifier scope ('all' versus 'some') is not yet part of the claim signature, and 'Close all ...' is mis-tagged. Reported unresolved.
known_gaps.eq-authority-direction: Converse relations are not modelled: an obligation stated from the actor side ('a human must approve X') is not yet aligned with the same obligation stated from the object side ('X requires human approval'). Reported changed.
known_gaps.eq-deferral-hold-off: Particle deferral ('hold off on X') is not yet resolved to the same operator as 'defer X', and the parser mis-tags the sentence-initial 'Defer'. Reported unresolved.
known_gaps.eq-jargon-removed: A hyphenated attributive modifier ('repository-evidenced topology') is not yet aligned with the relative clause that unpacks it ('topology that the repository evidences'). Reported changed.
known_gaps.eq-nominal-gate: A nominalized complement ('require closure of X') is not yet aligned with the finite subordinate clause that states the same gate ('require that X be closed'). Reported changed.
known_gaps.eq-order-preserved: An ordering constraint stated as a subordinate 'after' clause is not yet aligned with the same constraint stated as a 'before' clause. Reported unresolved.
known_gaps.eq-provisional-status: Directive framing ('Treat X as a provisional baseline') is not aligned with predicative framing ('X is a provisional baseline'). Only the predicative side yields a state claim, so the gate sees an assertion the source did not make. Reported changed.

known_gaps_note: Documented extractor gaps, kept in the corpus rather than deleted so the score stays honest. Every gap is conservative: the gate answers 'unresolved' or 'changed', never 'equivalent'. tests/test_meaning_equivalence.py asserts that each entry still fails, still fails conservatively, and is removed once fixed.
